title: Just Juice Exotic Fruits Pineapple Papaya & Coconut 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice's Pineapple Papaya & Coconut e-liquid is a tropical trip that’s bursting with exotic flavours. Experience the perfect interplay between the sharp, lively tang of Pineapple, the juicy burst of luscious Papaya and the rich, evocative smoothness of Coconut, all in one enchanting flavour blend from Just Juice. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids due to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. Furthermore, nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration. With blends tailor-made to light up your tastebuds, UK E-liquid legends Just Juice create the tangiest, tastiest, fruitiest flavours around. The flavours are long-lasting, less allergenic and easier on the throat than many alternative e-liquids and come in 50/50, Nicotine Salt and Shortfills.
